title: Behavioral Capacity Certificates for Quantized Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.37887v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Activation and key-value cache precision change what a quantized language model computes without altering its stored weights. Direct weight-code bounds, however, assign identical complexity to deployments that behave differently and charge separately for weight codes that behave identically. Behavioral Capacity Certificates (BCC) charge for behavior using the aggregate prior mass of complete implementations---weights, scales, activation and cache rules---that induce the same bounded loss. When quantization merges implementations, this shared mass lowers the complexity penalty, and a break-even law determines when the saving survives the cost of validating it. BCC supports a three-step deployment workflow, and our experiments verify each step. First, a forward-only screen shortlists per-layer bit-widths by how often candidate perturbations preserve the reference predictions, with quality comparable to Hessian-guided selection at lower pre

translated_title: 量化语言模型的行为容量证书
translated_abstract: 激活值和键值缓存精度会在不改变模型存储权重的情况下改变量化语言模型的计算结果。然而，直接的权重编码界限会给行为不同的部署分配相同的复杂度，并对行为相同的权重编码分别计费。行为容量证书（BCC）基于完整实现（包括权重、缩放因子、激活规则和缓存规则）的聚合先验质量来对行为计费，这些实现产生相同的受限损失。当量化合并了多个实现时，这种共享质量可降低复杂度惩罚，而盈亏平衡法则决定了这种节省何时能够覆盖验证它的成本。BCC 支持三步部署工作流程，我们的实验对每一步都进行了验证。首先，仅前向传播的筛选方法根据候选扰动保持参考预测的频率来初选每层位宽，其质量可与 Hessian 引导的选择相媲美，且预计算成本更低。
tldr: 本文提出行为容量证书（BCC），通过聚合产生相同受限损失的全部实现的先验质量来为量化语言模型的行为计费，使量化合并实现时降低复杂度惩罚，并借助盈亏平衡法则和仅前向筛选等三步工作流程指导实际部署。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Behavioral Capacity Certificates (BCC), which charge for the behavior of quantized language models via the aggregate prior mass of complete implementations inducing the same bounded loss, lowering complexity penalties when quantization merges implementations, with a break-even law and a three-step deployment workflow guiding practical use.
